columns.name: SCHED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Primary Key column containing a random generated number.  This column is not updateable.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_REQUEST_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of the request as specified by the exporter

columns.name: REQUEST_TIME
columns.description: Submission time of the request

columns.name: REQUEST_TIME_STR
columns.description: REQUEST_TIME_STR

columns.name: REQUEST_SOURCE
columns.description: Exporter code or name of the request sender

columns.name: STATUS_IMP
columns.description: Status for the import phase

columns.name: STATUS_INT
columns.description: Status for the internalization phase

columns.name: SCHED_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Stores the resolved schedule unit identifier

columns.name: IMPORT_MODE
columns.description: Stores the import mode, such as FULL or UPDATE

columns.name: IMPORT_START_DATE
columns.description: Stores the import period start date for the range

columns.name: IMPORT_END_DATE
columns.description: Stores the import period end date for the range

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Group identifier. A group contains one or several schedule events and is the partioning unit. Used by the Process Imported Shifts process.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the processed Process Imported Shifts process or the process that's processing the schedule event.

columns.name: CHILD_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the child Process Imported Shifts process that processed the schedule event.

columns.name: PUBLISH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to publish the schedules

columns.name: VALIDATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to validate the schedules

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE_ID
